**About The Job**
Mistral AI is seeking Applied Scientists to build frontier cybersecurity models. You will develop SOTA models across different domains of cybersecurity, from vulnerability analysis to incident response and remediation. You’ll build the environments, training-data pipelines, and evaluations that make these capabilities real and measurable. You'll work closely with cybersecurity actors and real production data, as well as cross-functionally with science, engineering, and product teams teams to deliver high-impact, trustworthy AI for security.
  
  
We are made of researchers, engineers, product builders, ex-founders who love tackling the most complex real world problems in the industry. You might come from security with a genuine interest in AI science, or from AI science with a genuine interest in security, both paths fit. What matters is curiosity for the side you know less well, and the drive to go deep on it.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Develop, pre-train and post-train domain-specialized foundation models for agentic defensive security.
* Work across a diverse set of complex real world problems to build the future of AI for cybersecurity.
* Design evaluations and benchmarks that measure realistic security capability on customer-representative tasks.
* Build sandboxed execution environments, RL tasks, and verifiers grounded in real customer workflows, and generate and curate the training data for training frontier models.
* Develop the necessary tools and frameworks to facilitate data generation, model training, evaluation and deployment.
* Own technical delivery across project sprints and manage research communications with customer teams.

**About You**

* Fluent in English with excellent communication skills: at ease explaining complex technical to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience building harnesses, benchmarks or RL environments for code, agentic or security tasks.
* Hands-on security background in one or more of: vulnerability research, exploit development, red teaming, or detection and incident response.
* Not afraid of contributing to a big codebase; finds their way around independently with little guidance.
* Writes clean, readable, high-performance, fault-tolerant Python code.
* Doesn’t need roadmaps: moves independently and navigates uncertainty with confidence.
* Low-ego, collaborative and eager to learn.
* Track record of success through personal projects, professional projects or academia.

Nice to have
  
  

* PhD / Master in a relevant field (Mathematics, Security, Machine Learning). Exceptional candidates from other backgrounds welcome
* Contributions to a large open-source or industry codebase.
* Publications in top ML/security venues and/or contributions to open-source security or observability tools.
* Experience working on large code bases or large machine learning models at scale.
* Enjoys improving existing code: typing, tests, CI pipelines.

Its digital services connect members with licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians, helping people find care that fits their needs. Talkspace’s mission is grounded in the belief that mental healthcare should be within reach for everyone. The company brings together technology, clinical expertise, and a commitment to reducing barriers and stigma around seeking support. As part of a diverse, purpose-driven organization, team members contribute to improving access to care for individuals and communities.
  
  
**About The Role**
Talkspace is seeking an experienced Data Analyst to join its Data Science team and support the development of Sentia’s agentic behavioral health platform. In this role, you will turn complex data into clear insights that inform product decisions, business strategies, and provider network operations. You will work with technical and non-technical partners across the organization, presenting findings in a way that supports practical action and sound decision-making.
  
  
This position offers the opportunity to contribute to the early design and architecture of the data warehouse, establishing dependable foundations for reporting and analytics. You will examine user journeys, marketplace dynamics, business outcomes, and platform performance, including measures such as model accuracy, latency, conversation depth, and adherence to behavioral protocols. This is a remote position based in Eastern Time hours, with Talkspace headquartered in New York City. The base salary range is $110,000 to $130,000, with placement determined by relevant experience, skills, education, and applicable certifications.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Three to five years of experience in a data, business, product, or comparable analytical role.
* A bachelor’s degree in statistics, applied mathematics, economics, computer science, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proficiency in SQL and Python, with strong working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.
* Experience applying statistical methods, manipulating data, and translating analysis into useful conclusions.
* Advanced capability with data visualization platforms such as Looker or Tableau.
* Experience with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel is valuable.
* Familiarity with healthcare data, including patient outcomes or capacity planning, is an advantage.
* Experience using generative AI tools is a plus.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.

**Responsibilities**

* Gather stakeholder requirements and query databases to deliver reporting and analysis for internal teams and external partners.
* Develop and improve dashboards and visualizations that explain user engagement, outcomes, provider network performance, and business trends.
* Create automated quality reports and network performance dashboards using Looker and related tools.
* Use SQL and Python to analyze business, provider, consumer, and product data, identifying meaningful patterns and opportunities.
* Build, document, and maintain scalable data models, including models developed with dbt, to support trusted downstream analytics.
* Partner with engineering teams to improve ETL and ELT processes and promote timely access to reliable, high-quality data.
* Collaborate with Data Science, product, business, finance, and marketing partners to shape strategies and improve provider network operations.
* Evaluate the needs and incentives of different participants in a multi-sided marketplace.
* Assess agentic platform metrics and communicate clear, actionable recommendations to stakeholders and senior leadership.

**Benefits**
Talkspace offers medical, dental, and vision coverage, along with pre-tax HSA and FSA options. Eligible employees can participate in a 401(k) retirement savings program with company matching up to 3%. Additional voluntary benefits may include disability, basic life, and pet insurance. The company also provides flexible paid time off, a remote-first work environment, team-building activities, wellness workshops, and access to Talkspace products for employees and one household member, plus a friends and family discount.

**What We're Looking For**
We need a high-caliber engineer who has shipped production systems at top-tier engineering organizations. You should be comfortable working at founding-stage intensity — owning features end-to-end, shipping directly to enterprise customers within weeks, and operating with minimal scaffolding. Bonus points if you have distributed systems, security engineering, or applied ML depth, or come from a quant/competitive programming background.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own and ship entire features end-to-end that go live with Fortune 500 enterprise customers within weeks
* Build the data plane that ingests an enterprise's entire AI footprint — high-volume, heterogeneous telemetry from EDR, network, identity, and model gateways
* Design and implement real-time detection and policy enforcement for novel agent failure modes
* Work directly with enterprise customers during POCs and deployments, often shipping features mid-engagement
* Train small models to make fast inline judgments against behavioral baselines under tight latency budgets
* Red-team models and agents to find failures before customers do — prompt injection, tool misuse, data exfiltration, scope drift
* Shape the architecture and technical direction of the platform alongside a small, intense founding team

**Tech stack**
Go, Rust, Distributed Systems, Streaming Pipelines, LLMs, ML/Post-Training, Real-time Data Infrastructure, EDR Integrations, Cloud Infrastructure
